chunks: A man came to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and complained to him of need, and he went to excess in complaining until he was about to complain of hunger.
So Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to him, “O you, do you pray at night?” The man said, “Yes.”

Then Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام turned to his companions and said, “He has lied who claims that he prays at night and goes hungry by day. Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has guaranteed for the night prayer the sustenance of the day.”

key_terms.قُوتَ النَّهَارِ: the sustenance or provision of the day

ai.seo_question: How does salat al-layl relate to a believer’s daily sustenance?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the spiritual and material blessing associated with salat al-layl. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rejects the claim that one truly committed to the night prayer would be left without daytime provision, emphasizing Allah’s guarantee of sustenance for those devoted to this act of worship.
